packages.name: 5-Day Introduction to Jesus
packages.description: A simple five-day reading plan that walks through key passages revealing who Jesus is, why He came, what He taught, how He died and rose again, and what it means to follow Him.
packages.author: Theodia

packages.name: Read the Bible in a Year
packages.description: A one-year reading plan that walks through every chapter of the Protestant Bible from Genesis to Revelation in canonical order, averaging about three chapters per day.
packages.author: Theodia
